question:
Refer to the exhibit. The Cisco NX-OS scheduler must run every day at 3:00 a.m. Which code snippet completes the script?
1 configure terminal
2 scheduler job name BACKUP_JOB
3 cli copy running-config bootflash:/$(NAME).$(TIMESTAMP).cfg
4 exit
5 scheduler schedule name BACKUP_SCHEDULE
6 job name BACKUP_JOB
7 ______
8 end
theory: The Scheduler's periodic timetable syntax for a once-daily job is exactly 'time daily HH:MM', so 'time daily 3:00' correctly binds the job to run every day at 3 a.m. 'time start daily 3:00' isn't valid syntax (start pairs with a one-time or delta schedule, not daily), and the weekly variants require a day-of-week/month argument and a different keyword form entirely, so they don't produce a simple daily 3 a.m. run. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
